annotations.message:
[injection, CWE-89] SQL injection in order lookup
Rule: injection
CWE: CWE-89
Verdict: verified, confidence 92%

The id query parameter reaches a SQL string.

Rationale: Any unauthenticated caller can read the orders table.

Fix: Suggested replacement:
cur.execute("select * from orders where id = %s", (order_id,))

[xss, CWE-79] Reflected XSS in the search view
Rule: xss
CWE: CWE-79
Verdict: verified

The query is written into the page unescaped.

Rationale: The value is passed to innerHTML.

[crypto] Weak hash for session ids
Rule: crypto
Verdict: new

MD5 is used for a session id.

[secrets] Secrets in repository history
Rule: secrets
Verdict: new

A token-like string appears in a past commit.
